summary: A thin notification bar that appears at the top of the content area, like a permission request.
description: A dismissable, prioritized notification bar shown at the top of browser content (e.g. permission prompts, site warnings). Managed by a NotificationBox container and rendered as a <notification-message> element that extends the modern Lit-based moz-message-bar component; the notification-message layer itself is classic (no JSDoc), lazily registered the first time a notification is shown.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Notification id, set via setAttribute("value", type); used to look up a specific open notification.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Derived from priority: "system", "critical", "info", or "warning"; drives icon/color styling. Inherited property from moz-message-bar.

attributes.name: message-bar-type
attributes.description: Set unconditionally to "infobar" by appendNotification(); internal CSS-targeting hook, not caller-facing config.

attributes.name: dismissable
attributes.description: Inherited from moz-message-bar; controls whether the close button is shown.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Inherited property from moz-message-bar for an optional bold heading line.

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: Inherited property from moz-message-bar; the notification's body text (also settable via the label setter, which accepts a string or an {l10n-id, l10n-args} object).

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: Inherited from moz-message-bar; when set, renders a "Learn more" support link.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Plain JS instance property (0-9, PRIORITY_SYSTEM through PRIORITY_CRITICAL_HIGH) set by appendNotification(); determines the type attribute.

attributes.name: persistence
attributes.description: Plain JS instance property; number of location changes the notification survives before auto-removal.

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.description: Plain JS instance property; a timestamp after which the notification is treated as expired.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Managed internally via setAlertRole(); typically "alert", not caller-set.

slots.name: message
slots.description: Inherited from moz-message-bar; falls back to the internal message span if empty.

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: Inherited from moz-message-bar; link-type buttons added via setButtons() are placed here.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Light-DOM span (class notification-button-container) populated by setButtons() with command/primary buttons.

events.name: AlertActive
events.description: Plain Event dispatched right after a notification is shown, for accessibility APIs.

events.name: message-bar:close
events.description: Inherited from moz-message-bar; CustomEvent dispatched in disconnectedCallback().

events.name: message-bar:user-dismissed
events.description: Inherited from moz-message-bar; cancelable CustomEvent dispatched from dismiss(); if not defaultPrevented, the bar closes and removes itself.

methods.name: appendNotification
methods.description: On the owning NotificationBox; creates and shows a notification-message.

cssProperties.name: --info-bar-background-color-configurable
cssProperties.description: Per-notification override, settable via element.style on the instance.

cssProperties.name: --message-bar-icon-container-margin-block-start
cssProperties.description: Top margin of the icon container.

usage: <notification-message type="warning" dismissable="true" message="Firefox prevented this site from asking you to install software." supportPage="unwanted-software"></notification-message>
